people.name: Solomon's_Portico
people.line: Colonnade in Jerusalem's temple where apostles taught

translations.web: By the hands of the apostles many signs and wonders were done among the people. They were all with one accord in Solomon’s porch.
translations.bsb: The apostles performed many signs and wonders among the people, and with one accord the believers gathered together in Solomon’s Colonnade.
translations.kjv: And by the hands of the apostles were many signs and wonders wrought among the people; (and they were all with one accord in Solomon's porch.
